description: This shell script is a test suite for verifying the correct handling of submodule operations involving symlinks in Git. It checks scenarios such as updating submodules behind symlinks, restoring submodules with symlinked repositories, and ensuring that Git does not follow or migrate symlinked directories during these operations.

methods.name: prepare_symlink_to_repo
methods.description: Prepares a symlinked repository setup used in multiple test cases. It initializes a Git repository in 'a/target', fetches from an upstream, and creates a symlink 'a/sm' pointing to 'target'.
